items.applies_to: alloys along with the diffusion couples
items.quote: The alloys along with the diffusion couples were further examined by means of a SEM (JEOL JSM6360LV) equipped with EDX system in backscattered electron (BSE) imaging mode.

items.label: Mg/(Nd-Zr)-type diffusion couples
items.quote: Three different Mg/(Nd-Zr)-type diffusion couples of approximate dimensions of 4 mm 9 8 mm 9 12 mm were made of the Nd-Zr alloy 4 (Nd80Zr20), alloy 5 (Nd50Zr50), and alloy 6 (Nd20Zr80) annealed at 773 K (500 °C) with pure block Mg.
items.starting_materials: Nd-Zr alloy 4 (Nd80Zr20), alloy 5 (Nd50Zr50), and alloy 6 (Nd20Zr80) annealed at 773 K (500 °C) with pure block Mg

items.purity: 99.9 wt pct-purity Nd and 99.95 wt pct-purity Zr
items.quote: The blocks of the 99.9 wt pct-purity Nd and 99.95 wt pct-purity Zr were used as the raw materials for the preparation of the Nd-Zr alloys.

items.purity: 99.9 wt pct pure Mg, 99.5 wt pct pure Nd, and 99.9 wt pct pure Zr
items.quote: The powders of 99.9 wt pct pure Mg, 99.5 wt pct pure Nd, and 99.9 wt pct pure Zr all with the same powder size of 44 lm were used as starting materials and mixed according to the selected compositions.

items.atmosphere_or_container: sealed in an iron capsule backfilled with high-purity argon

items.instrument: GeminiZeiss microscope equipped with an energy-dispersive spectrometer (Bruker AXS)
